title.rendered: “Like” us on Facebook! NEW SSD Page Published

content.rendered: Sherwood School District has relaunched its Facebook page with a new and improved design!  Be sure to visit and “Like” the Sherwood School District page and share the link with your students and families to keep up to date on the latest news and information from the District!
